name: Gaussian Splat Projection and Sorting
definition: A compute shader that projects 3D Gaussians to 2D screen space, culls invisible splats, computes lighting, and prepares data for sorting by tile and depth.
summary: Gaussian Splat Projection and Sorting projects 3D Gaussians to 2D screen space, culls invisible splats, and generates tile-based sorting keys to optimize volume rendering.
